name: Kadokura Kanae
source:
A beautiful widow who runs a public bath in the Downtown. She lost her husband when her daughters were very young so she raised them by herself afterwards. Recently, though, she has been making losses as managing the public bath becomes more and more difficult.

She has a high opinion of our protagonist who helps her with work and gives good advice to her. As she still needs more money for her daughters' future, she decides to go along with our protagonist's public bath management plan. Also, all that work with soap has made her sexually frustrated.
